as_told.title: Gleason couldn't sleep for weeks, built a UFO-shaped house, had 5,000 UFO books

plain: A man named Jackie Gleason is said to have built himself a house shaped like a UFO in upstate New York. Joe Rogan, a guest on the show, describes it as a circular wooden house with windows all the way around that looks like a giant flying saucer. Jesse Michels tells it too, citing Gleason's ex-wife, Beverly McKittrick: he says Gleason could not sleep for weeks after an experience, owned some 5,000 books on UFOs, and then built the house. It is told as a sign of how seriously Gleason took the subject.
